name: novelai-image-mcp
description: NovelAI image generation as an MCP server, sharing the request builder with the Scripting app.

scripts.build: esbuild stdio.ts http.ts backfill.ts backup.ts webpass.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs && esbuild web/app.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=preact --minify --outfile=dist/web/app.js
